name: TLE2071 / TLE2072 / TLE2074 (A grades)
tagline: TI's fast Excalibur JFET op-amp (10 MHz, 40 V/µs); one Head-Fi CMoy builder rated it the best cheap 9 V pick of ~20.

lineage.note: Sole source. TLE2072 macromodel dated 02/11/91; datasheet SLOS181 first issued February 1997. Models SLOJ112, SLOJ113, SLOJ114.
Automotive TLE207x-Q1 / TLE207xA-Q1 derivative with its own datasheet SGLS226 (SGLS226A, SGLS226B).

part_numbers.note: Single; PDIP and SOIC. In PCN 20231219013.1. Offset-null pins reportedly only on ceramic JG.
Tighter-offset A grade; TLE2071ACDR listed in PCN 20231219013.1.
Dual; the audio part. Digi-Key 296-10426-5-ND, Mouser 595-TLE2072CP/595-TLE2072IDR, LCSC C30340.
Dual A grade; TLE2072ACP in CERN DIY particle detector BOM (Farnell 3117956).
Quad; TLE2074CDWR is SOIC-16 wide. TI product page live.
Quad A grade; datasheet symlink tle2074a.pdf is live.
M-temperature A quad; GPN resolves to TLE207x datasheet. 5962 SMD unchecked.
Automotive group, datasheet SGLS226; orderables unchecked, so channels unset.
Die form in SLOS181A (2000); dropped by SLOS181C (2009), probably obsolete.

key_specs.value: P-channel JFET pair; input range includes V+

key_specs.source: no TI figure or measurement found

reputation.summary: A niche budget favourite, not a legend. On Head-Fi (c. 2007–2009) one user who tried about 20 op-amps rated the TLE2072 the best cheap choice for a 9 V CMoy, ahead of OPA2132 and OPA2134; others agreed at low supply and noted lower battery drain. The ohdsp open-hardware ADC/DAC boards use it. No ASR or Samuel Groner measurements exist.
typical_uses: 9 V JFET charge preamps (CERN DIY particle detector)
caveats: Praise rests on a few Head-Fi posts. Lore: TLE2072 has better DC, TLE2082 better AC specs; TI's models match.
JFET noise (~11.6 nV/√Hz typ, 17 max) is well above bipolar audio parts; matters in low-impedance, high-gain stages.
Modest output current (~25 mA); buffer low-impedance headphones.
Input range includes V+ but stops volts above V-; offset-null pins reportedly only on ceramic JG (plastic pins 1/5/8 NC).
Faster than the TL07x it replaces (10 MHz, 40–45 V/µs); decouple well and watch capacitive loads.

counterfeit_notes: No TLE207x fakes reported. Treat marketplace 'TLE2072' DIPs as unverified; buy from Digi-Key (296-10426-5-ND) or Mouser (595-TLE2072CP / 595-TLE2072IDR). Bench check: about 40–45 V/µs slew and tens of pA bias; a remarked TL072/TL082 slews only ~13 V/µs.

silicon_changes.identification: Same part number. Die-revision field A/B/C/H → A; chip site RFAB (Richardson, USA). Identify by date code or lot after first ship (date unknown). TLE2074 coverage unknown.
silicon_changes.summary: PCN 20231219013.1 ('Qualification of RFAB using ...') moves TLE207x orderables to TI's RFAB wafer fab with a die revision, assembly-site change and updated thermal data, following the TL07x and LF353. The datasheet was later retitled without 'JFET-Input'. No electrical deltas known. Mouser copy dated 22 Dec 2023.

spec_deltas.after: changed/added (per PCN summary; site not retrieved)
updated values in the PCN (numbers not retrieved)

silicon_changes.audio_impact: Unknown. A revised die may change noise, slew, output behaviour and stability margin under unchanged limits, as with LF353 and TL07x.

silicon_changes.verification: Digi-Key PCN copy names TLE2071ACDR, TLE2072CDR and fab, die, assembly changes. New datasheet revision letter unconfirmed.
